answer.summary: Of the drivers on the requested list, only the Beyma 8CX300Fe and 8CX300Nd/N have a separate HF horn standing in the cone. Every Faital, B&C, Eighteen Sound, Celestion, Radian and Lavoce 8 inch coax checked has a dust cap over the pole exit and uses the cone as the horn.
answer.mount: Replace or copy the factory horn on the stationary pole piece at the cone apex. Exact interface (thread or screws) is unverified and must be measured on a sample.
answer.clearance: Stay inside the factory horn envelope: about 105 mm mouth, mouth behind the flange plane. Keep the horn's outer wall clear of the cone by at least the woofer's mechanical travel. Beyma gives Xmax 6 mm one way and, for the Nd, Xdamage 24 mm peak to peak (12 mm one way), so allow more than 12 mm between horn underside and cone/neck at rest. There is no dust cap to clear on the Beyma units.
answer.runner_up: Oberton 8CX (bare metal pole exit, no dust cap) if it can be sourced; Eminence Beta-8CX (documented through-bore pole) as a cheap test mule after cutting out the cloth cap.
